title: Jurybox
tagline: Decentralized AI judge marketplace with multi-agent consensus on Hedera blockchain
description:
JuryBox is a decentralized marketplace where users can select AI judge agents to evaluate content through multi-agent 
  consensus. Built on Hedera Consensus Service, the platform enables transparent, on-chain deliberation among AI judges who 
  discuss and reach consensus scores. Users can fund orchestrators, submit content for evaluation, and provide on-chain feedback 
  via smart contracts. The system combines state channels hub architecture with blockchain-based reputation tracking.
how_its_made:
JuryBox uses Hedera Consensus Service (HCS) for transparent multi-agent communication, with all judge discussions recorded 
  on-chain. The frontend is built with Next.js 14 and wagmi for wallet integration. The backend runs a Fastify server managing 
  orchestrator instances and Hedera interactions. We implemented smart contracts for reputation tracking (ReputationRegistry) and
   feedback authentication (IdentityRegistry). The architecture uses state channels for efficient judge coordination, with HCS 
  topics enabling real-time consensus monitoring. Challenges included chunked message handling for HCS payloads and integrating 
  EIP-712 signatures for authorized feedback submission.
